name: agreements
description: Agreements: proposals, statements of work, contracts and any PDF, prepared and signed with a simple electronic signature.
agentInstructions: Agreements holds the organization's proposals, statements of work, contracts and NDAs, each with its own number, and the templates they are made from.

listing.summary: Agreements: drafts, versions, templates and simple electronic signatures.

project_time_budgets.description: Whether the project the signed agreement started uses time and budgets, as projects answered when it was made.

project_timebox_minutes.description: The project's whole timebox in minutes, as last set from this agreement (its proposal, then each accepted change request).

imported_text.description: Text read from an imported PDF, kept as unverified: never the signed text.

cross_app_calls.reason: one Knowledge document per signed version, closed to the organization and shared by name, from the version's frozen text
a superseding signed version archives the Knowledge copy of the version before it
a signed proposal or statement of work starts its project once, named by the agreement so a replay finds it (no assignee, time or activity read)
the change request's reply leaves from the person's own mailbox, under the card's mail check
an accepted change request adds one milestone task to its parent's project, as the person who sent it
an accepted change request grows its parent project's whole timebox by its hours, as the person who sent it; projects answers whether the project uses time and budgets
an accepted change request adds one milestone for its price to its parent project's billing plan, once, as the person who sent it; a project without a plan gets none
the clients under a signed agreement are kept in the app's own contact group, whose authenticated mail the Scope check reads, as the person who sent each agreement

home_load.description: Load the agreements list for the app's home page, in the order of what needs someone first.

agreements_search.description: Find agreements by status, company, kind or renewal date, ordered by what needs someone first.

agreement_get.description: Read one agreement: its parties, status, price, dates, versions and who can see it.

agreement_create.description: Create an agreement draft from a template or a brief, or from an uploaded PDF (kind other). Never sets a price.

agreement_import.description: File a contract signed before Liaison from its PDF: imported, with no evidence and no signature level. Its dates are set after with agreement_update.

agreement_update.description: Change an agreement draft: its text, dates or who can see it. An agent's change to who can see it waits for a person.

agreement_prepare.description: Check an agreement draft before sending: blanks, price, fit for this kind of signature, clauses an agent wrote.

agreement_price_set.description: Set the price of an agreement. A person's own action only.

agreement_passage_get.description: Quote one numbered section of a signed or sent agreement version, cut from its own text. Answers NOT_READABLE when the version has no readable text: then say you could not read it.

version_id.description: The agreement version id (agreement_get lists them).

agreement_id.description: Instead of version_id, an imported agreement (it has no version): quotes the text read from its PDF, unverified.

section.description: The section number, such as 8 or 8.2.

activity_read.description: The agreements of a company or of its people, one row each at its latest status, newest first, for their timeline. Read by the kernel.

templates_list.description: List the agreement templates with their kind, language and current version.

template_get.description: Read one agreement template at its current or a given version.

template_save.description: Save an agreement template as a new version; agreements made from earlier versions keep their text.

approval_route_read.description: Who an agreement concerns, for routing its approvals.

agreement_send.description: Send a frozen agreement version for signature or acceptance to its signers, in order or all at once. Parks for a person's approval; nothing is sent if the version changed since agreement_prepare.

sha256.description: The fingerprint agreement_prepare returned for that version.

sendGuard.description: Set by the server; leave it out.

guardKey.description: Set by the server; leave it out.

change_request_send.description: Reply to a client's mail and send them a change request on a signed agreement, in one card: the work, its hours with their source, the rate from the signed text and the passage it rests on. Parks for a person's approval; nothing is sent if the client wrote after the card.

parent_agreement_id.description: The signed agreement the change request adds to.

work.description: The work it adds, one line each.

hours_source.description: Where the hours come from, such as past similar work.

rate_minor.description: The hourly rate from the signed text, in minor units, as a string.

passage.description: The signed text's section, read with agreement_passage_get.

sendGuard.description: Set by the server; leave it out.

guardKey.description: Set by the server; leave it out.

agreement_reminder_send.description: Remind signers of an agreement waiting for signatures: each named signer whose link is still open gets a fresh link by mail, and the link mailed before stops working. Parks for a person's approval.

approvalCard.summary: Remind the signers of an agreement

client_action_ids.description: The signers' links to remind, all of one agreement version (agreement_get lists them).

sendGuard.description: Set by the server; leave it out.

guardKey.description: Set by the server; leave it out.

agreement_new_link.description: Give one signer a new signing link, at the same or a corrected address, in the same turn: after their link expired or was withdrawn, or after a decline made without the emailed code. Signatures already given stand. Parks for a person's approval.

approvalCard.summary: A new signing link for client action {{params.client_action_id}}

client_action_id.description: The signer's link to replace, from agreement_get or agreement_send.

email.description: A corrected address; leave it out to use the one on file.

agreement_void.description: Void an agreement waiting for signatures: every open signing link is withdrawn at once and signatures already given stay. Parks for a person's approval.

client_action_view_get.description: What a person outside is shown for one agreement version, with its fingerprint (internal: the kernel's client action page).

agreement_evidence_get.description: Read the evidence of a signed agreement: fingerprints, seal, timestamp, each signature and whether each signer's copy was sent. IP and browser need agreements:evidence:devices.

id.description: The agreement id or the signed version id.

agreement_verify.description: Check a signed agreement's evidence: re-hash the stored files and recompute the seal. A mismatch is recorded and reported, never repaired.

id.description: The agreement id or the signed version id.

translations.summary: {{data.number}} version {{data.version}} was sealed more than 24 hours ago and the outside timestamp has not arrived. The signers already have their copies; the stamped file follows when the authority answers.
The signed copy of {{data.number}} version {{data.version}} could not be mailed to {{data.signer}} after {{data.attempts}} tries. Send it from the evidence file.
{{data.number}} version {{data.version}} is signed but not sealed after an hour. The seal is retried every 10 minutes.
The seal of {{data.number}} version {{data.version}} does not match ({{data.what}}). Nothing was repaired; the signers' copies are the reference.

scope-check.description: When a client under a signed agreement writes, check the request against the signed text.
scope-check.promptTemplate: A client under a signed agreement wrote (the new mail is in the event; its sender's address passed the receiving provider's authentication). Find the client's signed agreement with agreements_search, then read the signed text with agreement_passage_get: never quote it from memory. Decide one of four things. In scope: say which section covers it, quoting that passage, and change nothing. Out of scope and the signed text names a rate: propose one change request with change_request_send (mail_message_id is this mail's id, so one mail gets one card), its hours labelled with where they come from and the rate from the signed text; a person approves the card, the reply and the price. Unclear: say what in the signed text is unclear, quoting it, and change nothing. Not a request: say nothing. Never reply to the client yourself and never send anything without the card.
